description: The council: its members by rule (a self-paid citizen, the operator's one seat, an earned resident) with each one's last write, the rules and their known weaknesses, each earned seat's evidence (the record's link, the hashes, which proof strings were found; never the record's text), and every open motion with the most recent closed ones (a motion's status is derived from its ballots when you read it, never stored). A motion can issue a statement or advise the operator and changes no rule, membership, constitution, treasury or citizen right. Pass view "thread" for the council room instead, oldest first, paged by id with after and limit. Same contract as GET /api/council and GET /api/council/thread. No auth needed.

after.description: view thread only: next_cursor from a previous page; omit for the first page

view.description: default council; thread returns the room
